create.title: Create Competition

type.title: What are you playing?
type.subtitle: Pick the type of competition. Everything else can be changed later.

RYDER_CUP.title: Ryder Cup
RYDER_CUP.blurb: Two teams, singles and pairs. The team with most points wins.

STABLEFORD.title: Stableford
STABLEFORD.blurb: Individual, points for how you score on each hole.

MEDAL.title: Medal
MEDAL.blurb: Individual, stroke play: lowest total wins.

create.golfCoursesSubtitle: Add golf courses for each country (at least one per country)
create.coursePendingApproval: This course is pending approval. You won't be able to activate the competition until it's approved.
create.maxPlayingHandicapHint: Max 1–54. Leave empty for no limit.

errors.datesRequired: Start and end dates are required
errors.endDateAfterStart: End date must be after start date
errors.playersMinimum: Number of players must be at least 2
errors.teamNamesTooShort: Team names need at least 3 characters
errors.handicapLimitRange: The handicap limit must be between 1 and 54
errors.playersInvalid: The number of players must be a whole number

create.partialSuccess: Competition created, but {{failed}} course(s) could not be added: {{courses}}. {{success}} course(s) were added successfully.
create.errorAddingCourses: Competition created, but golf courses could not be added. You can add them manually from the detail page.
create.moreOptionsIncomplete: Some options are missing: expand them to fill them in
create.visibilityPrivateHelp: It does not show when exploring: the people you invite are the ones who get in
create.visibilityPublicHelp: It shows when exploring and anyone can ask for a place; you still decide who gets in

setupMode.title: How much should the app do
setupMode.subtitle: You can change it while enrolment is open.

AUTOMATIC.title: Fully automatic
AUTOMATIC.blurb: The app builds the teams, names the captains and creates the matches. It only asks which days are played, in which slot and on which course.

MANUAL.title: Fully manual
MANUAL.blurb: You decide everything: teams, captains, rounds, matches and matchups.

RYDER_CUP.title: Ryder Cup style
RYDER_CUP.blurb: A live player draft (or teams by hand), captains you name, configurable rounds and matchups from envelopes.

edit.title: Edit Competition
edit.notEditable: This competition can no longer be edited: it can only be edited while enrolment is open.
edit.datesLeaveSessionsOut: Those dates leave these sessions out: {{sesiones}}. Move or delete them before changing the dates.

detail.creator: Creator
detail.invitingOpensEnrollment: Inviting the first person opens enrolment
detail.invitingOpensScheduled: Enrolment opens on its own on {{fecha}}. If you invite someone before then, it opens at that moment.

deleteModal.title: Delete the competition?
deleteModal.nobodyElse: It will be deleted for good, with its schedule and teams. Nobody else is enrolled.
deleteModal.unknownOthers: It will be deleted for good, with its enrolments, schedule and teams. Who else is enrolled could not be checked.
deleteModal.othersLosePlace_one: It will be deleted for good, with its schedule and teams, and {{count}} other player will lose their place.
deleteModal.othersLosePlace_other: It will be deleted for good, with its schedule and teams, and {{count}} other players will lose their place.
deleteModal.nobodyEnrolled: It will be deleted for good, with its schedule and teams. Nobody is enrolled.
deleteModal.playersLosePlace_one: It will be deleted for good, with its schedule and teams, and {{count}} player will lose their place.
deleteModal.playersLosePlace_other: It will be deleted for good, with its schedule and teams, and {{count}} players will lose their place.

activate.title: Activate the competition?
activate.body: Enrolment opens and people can sign up.

close-enrollments.title: Close enrolment?
close-enrollments.body: Nobody else can sign up, and invitations still pending lose their place.

cancel.title: Cancel the competition?
cancel.body: It is called off for everyone enrolled and cannot be undone.

reject-enrollment.title: Reject {{name}}'s request?
reject-enrollment.body: They will not join the competition.

reopen-enrollments.title: Reopen enrolment?
reopen-enrollments.body: The competition becomes active again and people can sign up.

revert-status.title: Go back to closed?
revert-status.body: You will be able to change the schedule again.

revert-to-in-progress.title: Reopen the tournament?
revert-to-in-progress.body: It goes back to in progress so you can, for example, add another round. Completed matches do not change.

errors.golfCourseRejected: Cannot activate competition: Golf course was rejected

errors.noGolfCourses: Cannot activate: No golf courses selected

errors.teamAssignmentFailed: Enrollments were closed, but automatic team assignment failed. You can assign teams manually.

namePreference.helpUsingAlias: In this competition you appear as {{alias}}, same as in quick matches.

golfCourses.title: Golf Courses ({{count}})
golfCourses.noCourses: No golf courses associated with this competition

removeDialog.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeDialog.body: It will no longer be one of this competition's courses.

golfCourses.requestNotAvailable: Requesting new courses is not available in this view. Use the competition creation page.

manualStart.title: This course has to be started by hand
manualStart.body: Scoring will not open by itself: the competition's organiser has to start the match, and they need a connection. If the course has no signal, better done before setting off.

golfCourses.courseAlreadyAdded: That course is already in the competition

captains.title: Name the captains
captains.explanation: One per team, from the enrolled players. Captains play too, and you can be one.
captains.closesEnrollment: Naming them closes enrolment: nobody else will be able to join.
captains.sameForBoth: One player cannot captain both teams: pick someone else for one of them.
captains.uneven_one: There is {{count}} player: the teams will not come out even. The captains stay named, but assigning the teams will need an even number.
captains.uneven_other: There are {{count}} players: the teams will not come out even. The captains stay named, but assigning the teams will need an even number.
captains.failed: The captains could not be named.
captains.playersUnavailable: The list of enrolled players could not be loaded. Open the competition again to retry.

browse.subtitle: Discover tournaments to join or explore completed competitions

joinCompetition.title: Join a Competition
joinCompetition.description: Find tournaments you can join and request enrollment
joinCompetition.noActiveCompetitions: There are no active competitions available to join at the moment

exploreCompetitions.title: Explore Competitions
exploreCompetitions.description: View ongoing tournaments and completed results
exploreCompetitions.noOngoingCompetitions: There are no closed, ongoing, or completed competitions at the moment

errors.alreadyEnrolled: You already have an enrollment request for this competition

success.enrollmentRequested: Enrollment request sent! Check "My Competitions" to track status.

enrollment.colorHint: Used to assign the right tees in matches

apertura.explicacion: This competition will be public: anyone can see it and ask for a place.
apertura.ahoraDetalle: It goes up when you create it and people can enrol straight away.
apertura.programada: A few days before the tournament
apertura.programadaDetalle: It is announced now and enrolment opens by itself on that day.
apertura.avisoAbreYa: The tournament starts before that, so enrolment will open as soon as you create it.

envelope.title: Your envelope
envelope.tapInOrder: Tap your players in the order you want them to play: the first one faces the rival's first.
envelope.oddTeam: This session is pairs and one team has an odd number of players: somebody would be left out, so the envelopes cannot be handed in and will not open on their own. The organiser has to change the session format or redo the teams.
envelope.pairHalfDone: The last pair is still missing a partner.
envelope.rivalIn: The rival has handed his in
envelope.rivalPending: The rival has not handed his in yet
envelope.filledByTheApp: One envelope was filled in by the app: its captain did not hand it in on time
envelope.filledByTheAppTeam: {{equipo}}'s envelope was filled in by the app: its captain did not hand it in on time
envelope.filledByTheAppBoth: Both envelopes were filled in by the app: neither captain handed theirs in on time
envelope.onlyCaptains: Envelopes are handed in by the captains. The matchups show up here once they are opened.
envelope.resetExplanation: Both envelopes and this session’s matches are thrown away, and the captains hand in again. Only while nothing has been played.
envelope.resetDone: Envelopes and matches redone: the captains can hand in again
envelope.revealWhenBothReady: Open them as soon as we have both handed in, without waiting for the hour
envelope.waitingForRivalToAgree: You have allowed opening them now; the other captain has yet to.
envelope.deadline: Deadline {{when}}. After that, whatever is missing the app fills in.
envelope.noDeadline: This session has no hour to open on its own: if you open it now, the app fills in whatever envelope is missing by handicap.
envelope.rivalConsented: The other captain has already given permission: if you do too, they open now.
envelope.opensOnItsOwn: Unless you both allow it, they open on their own on {{when}}.

draft.title: Draft room
draft.notStarted: The organiser has not launched the draw yet.
draft.notStartedYouLaunch: You haven't launched the draw yet. Once you do, the first captain's turn starts.
draft.pickedByTheApp: The app picked when the minute ran out
draft.lastIncluded: {{name}} joined your team as the last pick.
draft.turnLost: Your minute ran out and the app picked for you. It is the other captain's turn now.
draft.turnLostDraftOver: Your minute ran out and the app picked for you. That finished the draft.
